text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
July ☆, Noon. Wind: Rough, then calm. "I 
won't let you weigh this anchor." 
====================

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
The turning point in our constant mismatch 
was Air Shakur's advice: "Translate the 
data instead of just forcing raw numbers 
on them."

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
After hearing that, the Navigator's 
instructions became so much easier to 
understand, and the anchors of our hearts 
were finally linked!

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
I realized the path I thought was taking 
it easy was actually looking ahead to next 
year. If we steadily rack up the numbers, 
we'll make it in time for the big Classic 
races!

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
You were seeing the absolute best route 
all along. I knew it, I can't let anyone 
else be my navigator!
